full_svg_review.method: Five complete original SVGs rendered at 1800px and individually viewed; corresponding final public SVG bytes match exactly.

manual_ui_review.exact_final_source_covered_by: Final production browser reports and saved public response bytes

browser_source_provenance.rule: Preserve original report bytes. Legacy reports are associated by successful workflow run and original artifact; their own absent source fields are not invented.

historical_limits: No shared survey baseline is invented between separately sourced maps.
Unknown street gaps, bridgeheads, ancient banks, measurement endpoints and individual contemporaneity remain explicitly unresolved.
Source-record counts are not independent ancient-road counts; surveyed/excavated warehouse counts are not forced into one contemporaneous grid.
Original plans and primary publication pages listed in the node reviews remain acquisition targets.

archive_integrity.scope: Index contains exact bytes, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA. Final remote commit/tree/blob readback is a separate step whose actual output is recorded in Issue #52; this file does not self-certify its own archive.
